subject: Mathematics
title: Fiji Year 10 Mock Examination — Mathematics
instructions:
Answer ALL questions. Time allowed: 2 hours (an extra 10 minutes is allowed for reading).
Multiple-choice: click the letter of the best answer (click again to clear).
Short answers and paragraphs: type your answer in English in the box. Show working for calculations.
You may use a calculator. Round answers to 2 decimal places unless stated otherwise.
Your answers are saved automatically. The paper is submitted automatically when time runs out.
Some questions ask you to draw on the Cartesian plane — use the graph tools (point, line, curve, shading). Other diagrams are described in words.

questions.text:
A function is given as g(x) = x² − 3.
(i) Find g(−2), g(−1), g(0), g(1) and g(2). (1 mark)
(ii) Draw the graph of y = x² − 3 for −2 ≤ x ≤ 2 on the Cartesian plane. Plot the points and join them with a smooth curve. (2 marks)
questions.model:
(i) g(−2) = 1, g(−1) = −2, g(0) = −3, g(1) = −2, g(2) = 1 (1)
(ii) Five points plotted correctly (1); smooth U-shaped curve through them, not straight segments (1)

questions.text:
A straight line p passes through the points (0, 2) and (4, 0).
(i) Draw line p on the Cartesian plane. (1 mark)
(ii) Calculate the gradient of line p. (1 mark)
(iii) Write the equation of line p in the form y = mx + c. (1 mark)
questions.model:
(i) Straight line through (0, 2) and (4, 0) (1)
(ii) m = (0 − 2)/(4 − 0) = −½ (1)
(iii) y = −½x + 2 (1)

questions.text:
An inequality is given as y ≤ −x + 4.
(i) Find the x-intercept and the y-intercept of the line y = −x + 4. (1 mark)
(ii) Draw the inequality on the Cartesian plane: draw the boundary line (solid or broken?) and shade the region that satisfies y ≤ −x + 4. (1 mark)
questions.model:
(i) (4, 0) and (0, 4) (1)
(ii) SOLID line through (0, 4) and (4, 0) because of ≤, with the region BELOW the line shaded (test (0, 0): 0 ≤ 4 is true) (1)

questions.text:
Line L has the equation 2y − 4x = 6.
(i) Write the equation in the form y = mx + c. (1 mark)
(ii) State the gradient and the y-intercept. (1 mark)
(iii) Write the equation of the line parallel to L that passes through (0, −1). (1 mark)
